title: Directed by Michael Bay
blurb: Something explodes, someone walks away without looking back, and the credit lands. The joke essentially writes itself, which is why the format has outlasted almost every other caption meme: any real-life disaster can be retroactively awarded a two-hundred-million-dollar budget, three helicopters and a slow-motion pass. Bay's directorial signature is so consistent that a single title card is enough to invoke it. Use it on car park incidents, kitchen fires, and any moment where somebody accidentally achieves cinema. No CGI required, and no second take was ever necessary.
origin: The meme credit sting applied to explosive real-life moments.
